resources.string:
The manifest.json file hath missing or unskillful properties:
%s

Biseche ye the file and fonde eft.
Þy Samsung deuys is smiten wiþ a knowen defaute þat makeþ þe PRoot-founde termynal installynge to faylen.
Þe termynal now renneþ in a laste mode for a knowen compotabilitie defaute caused of a mysfare in þe PRoot enviroun on certeyn deuyses. Som þinges mowe be lymyted or do dyuersly.
